_note: Texts the Mac app needs that core/desktop/design/strings.en.json doesn't have yet (the shared file is a copy of raven-core's and must stay identical to it). Every key starts with mac. and only adds a text: Strings.shared loads this file after strings.en.json and never lets it replace a shared key. Move each text into the shared file with raven-core, then delete it here (MacUXFixesTests fails while a key is in both).
mac.groups.remove.title: Remove {name} from {group}?
mac.groups.remove.body: {name} stops getting this group's messages and can't write to it. Messages so far stay on this computer.
mac.groups.remove.notFriend: {name} isn't your friend, so you can't add them back: only your friends can be added to a group.
mac.add.share.includeAddressNone: Include my network address. Anyone you send this to can see it.
mac.add.noAddress.notReceiving: Your card has no network address: Raven is not receiving now. Your friend can still add you.
mac.add.noAddress.thisComputerOnly: Your card has no network address: Raven receives on this computer only, so friends on your network cannot reach you.
mac.add.noAddress.noNetwork: Your card has no network address: this computer is not on a network now.
mac.add.noAddress.other: Your card has no network address: Raven has none to share now.
mac.lock.plainBody: While Raven is locked it doesn't receive, read or send messages. Unlock to use it again.
